transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You shouldn't be here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm Salim, and I came because it's my fault my brother Omar was taken.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Keep your voice steady; this place listens closer than you think.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I dared him to insult the well, and a pale hand rose from the dark and dragged him down before I could save him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: That is how it begins; the pit does not rush, it simply claims.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Who are you to speak like you've seen it before?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I'm Hanash, bound to this fountain. I cannot leave it, and some days I forget how long I've stood here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You look like you've already lost something.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Small things go first — words I meant to say, the shape of a memory. I wake tired without ever moving.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me what you still remember before it's gone.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I remember enough to warn you.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Can you help me find Omar or tell me where to go?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I can't guide you. I can't leave. I don't know paths anymore.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then is there anything here that could help me?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: This place answers to the King of jinn, and he does not bend to pleas.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Is that King real, or just a story to frighten fools?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Real enough that most who chase him lose themselves first.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me how anyone faces him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is a gate tied to him, not a road but something paid for.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: And what stands at that gate?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: A creator guards it — maker, shaper… no, creator, though I do not truly know what it is.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You're unsure.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I'm telling you what survives in my head, and even that costs me.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then give me what you can.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Reaching him breaks most people before they matter to him.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'll take that risk.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is one thing I can give — not a map, not a road. Something to keep you from breaking before you get there.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Please. I'm begging you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: If I give it, I lose more than I can spare. Are you ready to carry what follows alone?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Yes, I am.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break. Say it once.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't repeat it. The square listens for echoes. There is one more — harder to give. My hands won't stop shaking.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I am still here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Prayer for the lost: Light find my hand. Light find my path. Let the Sword of Light answer, and let it fade when the shadows loosen. Never say it twice in the same dark.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I have both. I won't waste them.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Use the first when you feel yourself slipping. Use the second only when the pale hands reach you — not before. The order matters.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Stand firm, but know the cost is yours alone.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Thank you for giving me something when you didn't have to.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't waste it.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't forget you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Good luck, Salim.
